## Last-checked: 2026-09-18

# PromptBoard

PromptBoard is a local prompt manager and Windows tray app for reusable LLM prompts, skills, workflows, roles, and agents. It keeps prompt libraries offline, searchable, and copy-ready without requiring a cloud account or external API connections.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/file-bricks/promptboard
Default branch: main
Package name: promptboard
CLI script: promptboard (via `src\promptboard.py`)
Supported languages (Tier-2 6-language parity): `de` (Deutsch), `en` (English), `es` (Español), `zh` (简体中文), `ja` (日本語), `ru` (Русский)

Important boundaries:
- Purely local, runs offline on Windows (via PySide6 tray app).
- Disambiguation: Native Windows desktop app (Python/PySide6), NOT a SaaS/cloud web tool.
- No cloud account, external APIs, or telemetry required.
- Keeps libraries in local JSON format (`~/.promptboard/library.json`).
- Offscreen startup checks, system tray integration, and global hotkeys are Windows-native.
- Verified cross-compatible offscreen startup (smoke tests) on macOS/Linux.

Primary commands:
- python src\promptboard.py (run the desktop app)
- python -m pip install -e ".[dev]" (install developer dependencies)
- python manage_translations.py --check --stats (verify 158-key Tier-2 6-language parity)
- python scripts\check_store_readiness.py (verify Windows Store & Tier-2 listing readiness)
- python _tools\generate_store_screenshots.py (regenerate tray/store screenshots)
- python _tools\store_release.py msix-preflight --use-test-identity (run local MSIX preflight build)
- powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "_tools\run_wack.ps1" (run Microsoft WACK validations)

Verification:
- python -X utf8 -m compileall -q src _tools tests scripts (OK)
- python -X utf8 -m ruff check . (OK; all checks passed)
- python -X utf8 manage_translations.py --check (OK; 158/158 keys x 6 languages)
- python -X utf8 scripts\check_store_readiness.py (OK; 0 findings)
- python -X utf8 -m pytest -q (125 passed, 1 skipped baseline + a11y/store/i18n contract suites)
- python -X utf8 tests/source_platform_smoke.py (OK; source/offscreen scope)

Release boundary (readback 2026-09-18):
- Published GitHub artifact line: v1.1.3 (matches pyproject.toml metadata 1.1.3).
- Store identity harmonized on `Geiger.PromptBoard` / `CN=52596601-BAB4-4F3F-B182-E8F3F273B202` (`1.1.3.0`); elevated WACK / `makeappx.exe` signoff remains a local admin SDK step.

## Audience

Developers and power users building LLM-assisted workflows on Windows. Suitable for AI engineers, prompt engineers, and anyone managing reusable text blocks for language models.
